title: Closed stalk normalization of proper coherent duality
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $a:D(k)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be a right adjoint of $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Put $K=a(k[0])$. For every closed point $x\in X$, set $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and $\kappa(x)=A/\mathfrak m_x$ [def-weil-residue-field]. The local ring $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. The stalk complex $K_x$ is an algebraic dualizing complex over $A$: it is isomorphic to a bounded complex of injective $A$-modules [def-sp-injective-resolutions], every $H^j(K_x)$ is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and the scalar-action map $A[0]\to R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K_x,K_x)$ is an isomorphism in $D(A)$. Moreover it is normalized, meaning that there is an isomorphism
$$R\operatorname{Hom}_A(\kappa(x)[0],K_x)\cong\kappa(x)[0]$$
in $D(A)$. Here the stalk complex is obtained by applying the exact stalk functor to a representative of $K$, and $R\operatorname{Hom}$ is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] for the one-object ringed site. No dimension, reducedness, connectedness, smoothness or rationality hypothesis on $x$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0AWL (lemma-good-dualizing-normalized), specialized to S=Spec(k) with k[0]; proper adjoint identification: Tag 0AWI (example-proper-over-local).

proof.text: By the definition of properness, $f$ is of finite type. A field is Noetherian (its only ideals are $0$ and $k$), so $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is Noetherian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to obtain that $X$ is Noetherian. Apply [lem-sfb-proper-field-algebraic-dualizing] to the given adjoint $a$: $K$ has bounded coherent cohomology, $A$ is Noetherian, and $K_x$ has finite injective dimension (a bounded injective representative) and the scalar map $A[0]\to R\operatorname{Hom}_A(K_x,K_x)$ is an isomorphism. The cited node does not itself state finite generation of $H^j(K_x)$; it follows from bounded coherent cohomology: since stalks are exact [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](5), $H^j(K_x)=H^j(K)_x$; the coherent sheaf $H^j(K)$ is of finite type [pqf-def-coherent], so on a neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ there is a surjection $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to H^j(K)|_U$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](3) its stalk $A^{\oplus n}\to H^j(K)_x$ is surjective. It remains to prove normalization.

source.place: Tag 0AWL (lemma-good-dualizing-normalized), proof specialized to S=Spec(k); Tag 0AWI (example-proper-over-local).

proof.text: Fix a closed point $x$ and put $L=\kappa(x)$. By [lem-kun-closed-point-field](a), $L/k$ is finite. The canonical map $i:\operatorname{Spec}L\to X$ is a closed immersion by [lem-trf-closed-point-residue-immersion], hence finite and proper by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite] and [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper]. Put $\pi=fi:\operatorname{Spec}L\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. It is finite by the definition of a finite morphism and the finiteness of $L/k$, and flat by [lem-pc-flat-field]. The source and target of $i$ and $\pi$ are Noetherian, so their derived direct images have right adjoints by [lem-pc-noetherian-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]; denote these by $i^!$ and $\pi^!$.

source.place: Tag 0AWL (lemma-good-dualizing-normalized), proof specialized to S=Spec(k); Tag 0AWI (example-proper-over-local).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-finite-flat-duality-evaluation] to $\pi$ and the rank-one free sheaf $\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}k}$. It says that $\pi^!k[0]$ is a sheaf in degree zero and identifies its pushforward, with its $L$-action, with $\operatorname{Hom}_k(L,k)[0]$. Here $(b\lambda)(c)=\lambda(bc)$ for $b,c\in L$. Via [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] on the spectra of the two fields, this is the $L$-module $V=\operatorname{Hom}_k(L,k)$ in degree zero. No separability is used.

source.place: Tag 0AWL (lemma-good-dualizing-normalized), proof specialized to S=Spec(k); Tag 0AWI (example-proper-over-local).

proof.text: Proper composition [lem-sc-proper-upper-shriek-composition] applied to $i$ and $f$ gives $i^!K=i^!a(k[0])\cong\pi^!k[0]$. Thus $i^!K$ corresponds to $V[0]$ in $D(L)$.

source.place: Tag 0AWL (lemma-good-dualizing-normalized), proof specialized to S=Spec(k); Tag 0AWI (example-proper-over-local).

proof.text: Set $\mathcal F=i_*\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}L}$; it is coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-coherent]. Since $K$ is bounded below, finite duality [lem-sc-finite-duality-derived-hom] gives $Ri_*i^!K\cong R\mathcal Hom_X(\mathcal F[0],K)$. Take the stalk at $x$ and apply [lem-sfb-coherent-bounded-below-rhom-stalk]. Explicitly, on an open $U$, $i_*M(U)$ is $M$ if $x\in U$ and zero otherwise, for any $L$-module $M$; this functor is exact, and its stalk at $x$ is $M$ with scalar action through $A\to L$. Consequently $\mathcal F_x=L$ and $(Ri_*i^!K)_x\cong V[0]$ as $A$-complexes. We obtain $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(L[0],K_x)\cong V[0]$ in $D(A)$. This uses the derived comparison, not just separate isomorphisms of cohomology groups.

source.place: Tag 0AWL (lemma-good-dualizing-normalized), proof specialized to S=Spec(k); Tag 0AWI (example-proper-over-local).

proof.text: Choose a nonzero $k$-linear functional $\lambda:L\to k$ (a coordinate functional in a $k$-basis). The map $L\to V$, $b\mapsto(c\mapsto\lambda(bc))$, is $L$-linear for the action in Step 3 and injective: if $b\ne0$, choose $d$ with $\lambda(d)\ne0$ and evaluate at $c=b^{-1}d$. Both spaces have $k$-dimension $[L:k]$, so it is bijective. It is therefore also $A$-linear through $A\to L$. Combine its inverse in degree zero with Step 5 to obtain $R\operatorname{Hom}_A(\kappa(x)[0],K_x)\cong\kappa(x)[0]$ in $D(A)$, as claimed.
